name: claw-way-django builds from migrations (fresh database)
notes: Drops and rebuilds the designated test database from the migration graph, then compares to production. Safe: test_sqs_test_db is the sanctioned throwaway, and the script re-verifies production history afterwards.

checks.proves: a fresh database was built from the migration graph without error
the replay left production's migration history unchanged

does_not_prove: that the rebuilt schema contains the same columns, indexes or constraints as production — only the table count is compared
that the application works against that schema (the test suite is separate)
that production itself is migrated or healthy
anything about data restore: this builds empty tables, it does not restore a dump
